retained_changes: Resolve expression scalar types with one compact-HIR local traversal.
Resolve generic declaration owners with one compact-HIR local traversal.
Intern path-prefix pairs and publish their canonical slot in one atomic shader.
Project checked call artifacts only for compact call-expression HIR rows.
Reduce predicate diagnostics directly from producer-owned columns without a materialized per-HIR diagnostic table.
Treat compact method rows as the source of truth and stop clearing overwrite-only method-contract, validation-metadata, and trait-implementation link columns.
Project semantic function, type, and parameter columns only over their compact semantic domains and leave inactive workspace tails untouched.
comparison_note: The pass and existing Nsight shader-time reductions are deterministic. Warm wall time remains sensitive to concurrent desktop load and GPU clock state; retained runs span 186.83-203.89 ms after the changes versus a 221.19 ms recent baseline. The post-clear-change Nsight attempt captured only the parser submit segment, so it is retained as a diagnostic artifact but is not used as type-checker timing evidence.

rejected_experiment.description: Replace dependency canonical-root and reverse-subtree pointer jumping with local traversal.
rejected_experiment.disposition: fully reverted because reverse-subtree chains duplicated excessive memory traffic
